platform.terms.title: Terms and Conditions
platform.terms.intro: These terms govern your use of the Wasayel platform and every service offered through it. By using the platform or creating an account on it, you confirm that you have read and accepted them.
platform.terms.s1_body: The platform, referred to as we or us, means Wasayel, owned and operated by the following legal entity:
platform.terms.s1_note: You means the user or organisation that creates an account or subscribes to one of the platform plans.
platform.terms.s2_body: Wasayel is a software-as-a-service platform that lets a subscriber create and run their own online store or marketplace: listings, categories, roles, regions, conversations, deals, and visual identity.
platform.terms.s2_note: The platform provides the tool and is not a party to any transaction that takes place between the users of a subscriber store.
platform.terms.s3_body: An account is created with a phone number, an email address, or the Nafath digital identity, and is verified with a one-time code. You are responsible for the accuracy of your data and for all activity carried out from your account.
platform.terms.s3_note: We may refuse to create an account, or suspend one, if its data proves to be inaccurate or if it is used in breach of these terms.
platform.terms.s4_body: A store plan is granted for a defined period stated on the order. The store stays visible for the plan period and the grace period that follows it, and is then hidden until renewal.
platform.terms.s4_note: Nothing is deleted from the store data when it is hidden, and it returns exactly as it was as soon as the plan is renewed.
platform.terms.s5_body: Every subscription is covered by the refund policy published on a separate page, which forms an integral part of these terms. It includes a full 30-day refund guarantee.
platform.terms.s6_body: The platform may not be used for anything unlawful, nor to publish misleading, impersonating or abusive content, nor to send unsolicited bulk messages, nor to attempt to breach or disrupt the service or to reach data that is not yours.
platform.terms.s6_note: It may likewise not be used to sell anything whose sale is prohibited by law.
platform.terms.s7_body: Content published by a subscriber or by the users of their store — listings, images and messages — belongs to its authors and is their sole responsibility, and we do not review it in advance.
platform.terms.s7_note: We may hide any content that is reported to us or that breaches these terms.
platform.terms.s8_body: The platform software, its design and its trademark belong to us. The subscriber is granted only a non-exclusive, non-transferable right of use for the duration of their subscription.
platform.terms.s9_body: We may suspend or terminate the service on a material breach of these terms or on non-payment. You may terminate your subscription at any time by writing to us.
platform.terms.s10_body: The service is provided as is. We do not warrant that it will be free of interruption or error. In all cases our liability shall not exceed the amount you actually paid during the twelve months preceding the event.
platform.terms.s11_body: We may amend these terms. Any amendment is published on this page together with its date and takes effect from the date of publication. Continuing to use the service after that constitutes acceptance.
platform.terms.s12_body: These terms are governed by the laws of the following jurisdiction, whose courts have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising from them:

platform.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
platform.privacy.intro: This policy explains what the Wasayel platform actually collects, why it collects it, and who it is shared with. It is written against what the code stores, not in general terms.
platform.privacy.s1_body: The data controller is the legal entity that operates Wasayel:
platform.privacy.s2_intro: We collect only the following, and every item on this list is actually stored in our database:
platform.privacy.item_phone: Phone number or email address — the sign-in channel and the one-time verification code, together with a verified flag.
platform.privacy.item_nid: National identity number — only for those who choose to sign in with the Nafath digital identity; it is not requested on the other channels.
platform.privacy.item_name: Full name and profile picture, if you upload one.
platform.privacy.item_attributes: The profile attributes defined by the store you joined — both general ones and per-role ones.
platform.privacy.item_location: Location: the centre of your working area and its radius if you set them, and coordinates sent with submitting an offer or confirming arrival in ride applications.
platform.privacy.item_listings: The listings you publish, with their images, attributes and status.
platform.privacy.item_chats: Conversations between you and the other party inside a store.
platform.privacy.item_deals: Deals, offers, their statuses and their ratings.
platform.privacy.item_push: A push-notification subscription for each device and browser you authorise, if you authorise any.
platform.privacy.item_audit: An audit log of administrative actions: the action, its time and its actor, together with the network address and the browser user agent.
platform.privacy.item_prefs: Your preferences: language, appearance, and your choice about receiving notifications.
platform.privacy.item_terms: The date on which you accepted the terms and the version number you accepted.
platform.privacy.s3_body: We never collect or store your card details. Payment takes place entirely at the payment provider, and all that reaches us from it is the transaction identifier, its amount, its currency and its status.
platform.privacy.s3_note: We use no analytics or advertising tracking tool, and there is not a single advertising cookie on the platform.
platform.privacy.s4_body: We use functional cookies only: the sign-in session cookie for each store, the studio session cookie, and the selected-language cookie. There is no tracking or advertising cookie.
platform.privacy.s5_intro: We do not sell or rent your data. We share only what is necessary with the following parties, each of them measured from the code rather than listed for safety:
platform.privacy.share_otp: The SMS or email provider — to deliver the sign-in code to you alone.
platform.privacy.share_nafath: The Nafath digital identity service — only for those who choose it as a sign-in channel.
platform.privacy.share_payment: The payment provider — to carry out the subscription transaction and return its result.
platform.privacy.share_fonts: The web font service and the web file delivery network — your browser requests the font and the live-connection library from them, so your network address is visible to them.
platform.privacy.share_maps: OpenStreetMap — map tiles are requested from it when a screen containing a map is opened.
platform.privacy.share_legal: Competent authorities — on a binding legal request.
platform.privacy.s6_body: We keep your data for as long as your account exists and for as long as legal and accounting requirements demand. You can delete your account and your personal data from inside the app itself: the Account page, then Delete account; deletion takes effect as soon as you confirm. Transaction and invoice records remain without a name or contact details for as long as a legal or accounting obligation requires.
platform.privacy.s7_body: You may access your data, correct it, request its deletion, and withdraw your consent to notifications. Account deletion happens inside the app; for anything else, write to us at the contact email below.
platform.privacy.s8_body: All communication with the platform is encrypted over HTTPS, session cookies are protected and cannot be read from page script, and we do not keep the sign-in code in clear text.
platform.privacy.s9_body: Any change is published on this page together with its date. A material change is notified to the holders of active accounts.
platform.privacy.s10_body: For any question or request concerning your data, write to us at:
platform.refunds.title: Refund Policy
platform.refunds.intro: This policy applies to every paid subscription on the Wasayel platform and forms part of the Terms and Conditions.
platform.refunds.guarantee_body: If you are not satisfied with the service, we refund the full amount you paid within thirty (30) days of the payment date — no questions asked, and no conditions attached.
platform.refunds.s1_body: Send a message to the contact email below from the email address or phone number registered on your account, stating your store name and the payment date. There is no form and no extra step.
platform.refunds.s2_body: We reply to your request within two business days, and the refund is issued within five business days of it being accepted. The time for the money to reach your account after that follows the payment provider or the bank.
platform.refunds.s3_body: The amount is returned to the same payment method it was paid with, and in the same currency.
platform.refunds.s4_body: After the thirty days have passed, the elapsed part of the subscription period is not refunded. You may stop renewal at any time; the service then continues to the end of the period you paid for and stops there.
platform.refunds.s5_body: Nothing is deleted from your store data when a subscription stops. The store is hidden and returns exactly as it was as soon as it is renewed.
platform.refunds.s6_body: No refund is due for a subscription terminated because of a material breach of the acceptable use set out in the Terms.
platform.refunds.s7_body: To request a refund, or for any question about one, write to us at:
